## WF1 — job.closed listener

Path: `POST /webhook/siteproof-job-closed` (raw body)
HMAC: `sha256 = HMAC(WEBHOOK_SECRET, timestamp.rawBody)`
Dedupe: delivery id + job.id
After 202: fan-out **in parallel** to WF2–WF5.
WF2 PDF · WF3 routing · WF4 critical · WF5 sheet
Children skip / no-op when filters empty.
Config from `org.settings`. Callbacks use `X-Api-Key`.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ accepted: true, deliveryId: $json.deliveryId, jobId: $json.job.id, flags: $json.flags, duplicate: $json.duplicateDelivery || $json.duplicateJob }) }}

citedClause.text: Modules must be mechanically fastened at all specified clamp points.

findings.reason: All visible clamps show torque paint.
Label present but durability is questionable.
Exposed cabling at the inverter is not enclosed.
